text:
Ivy: quick a11y pass on the Model Runs panel this morning. Not blockers but a few behavior nits that confuse keyboard and SR users. Dropping notes so eng can triage.
Ravi: thanks Ivy, top-line?
Ivy: TL;DR: (1) skip-link jumps but disappears on reuse; (2) live announcer for streaming output is too chatty; (3) compact rows don't show focus-visible for icon-only actions; (4) table keyboard nav only tabs, no arrow support.
Priya: can you add repro steps and low-lift fixes first?
Ivy: repro 1 (skip): open Console > Model Runs, press Tab to top bar then Activate "Skip to runs". First time good, second time the link isn't reachable because we replace the node during a CSS animation. Quick fix: preserve the node in DOM and toggle `.visually-hidden` instead of recreating. Keep `tabindex=0` stable and add `aria-controls=\"runs-table\"`.
Ravi: agree. also ensure focus returns to the skip link if user Shift+Tab back to header.
Ivy: repro 2 (announcer): the streaming status is `div[aria-live=polite]` and we update every partial chunk. NVDA/VoiceOver read each small update. Proposed: debounce announcements and only publish milestone changes (started/paused/complete) and use `role=\"status\" aria-atomic=\"true\"`. Example: `announceDebounced(\"Run 12 started streaming\")` and only call when state changes.
Sam: yes — never use live updates for every token. For continuous content, prefer visually streaming content + sparse SR summaries. Also ensure `aria-hidden=true` on incremental output for SR if we provide a summary.
Priya: agree. note that some customers rely on real-time SR reads for monitoring — add a feature flag for verbose announcements so enterprise customers can opt-in.
Ivy: repro 3 (focus-visible): in compact mode our `.icon-btn` has `outline: none` and relies on subtle box-shadow that disappears on dark theme. Quick CSS: `.icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b66ff; }` and add `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` fallback.
Ravi: brand blue is a good default. Add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` considerations for animated focus transitions.
Ivy: repro 4 (keyboard nav): table currently sets interactive elements with tabindex but no row-level keyboard patterns. Options: convert the table container to `role=grid` with `role=row`/`role=gridcell` to enable arrow navigation, or add JS handlers to move focus on ArrowLeft/Right when a row has `tabindex=0`. Sam thoughts?
Sam: incremental approach: implement JS arrow handlers first to avoid sweeping role semantics changes. When focus is on a row (we add `tabindex=0` to the row), Left/Right should move to previous/next interactive cell; Enter opens the row action. Use `event.code === 'ArrowRight'` and `event.preventDefault()`, then `nextCell.focus()`. If we later change to `grid`, we'll need to audit all headers and announcements.
Ivy: also spotted the action menu trigger loses visible focus when opening the flyout because we immediately hide it with `aria-hidden` before overlay gets focus. Fix: set `aria-hidden` after overlay receives focus or keep focus outline on trigger during animation.
Priya: prioritization?
Ivy: propose: 1) keep skip-link node stable (low) 2) debounce/summarize live announcements + feature flag (med) 3) icon focus ring (low) 4) arrow-key handlers (med) 5) flyout focus handoff (low).
Ravi: timeline: I can PR 1 + 3 today, include screenshot swatches for contrast. Sam can pair on 2+4 next week.
Sam: I'll write NVDA/VO smoke tests for the announcer changes and arrow handlers. Also will validate the feature flag approach for verbose announcements.
a11y-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2248123456 — Contrast: PASS overall, WARNING on compact pill hover; Focus-visible: FAIL on 4 icon-only buttons; LiveRegion: FAIL (too frequent updates).
Priya: thanks — please add these to the design backlog card and tag QA. Also include before/after CSS in PRs and unit tests for keyboard behavior.
Ivy: added notes and screen grabs to the backlog: https://redwood-infra/board/667. Will follow up with a tiny design token update for the focus color. :white_check_mark:
